message.content: It appears that the connection pool managed by pgbouncer in the prod namespace has been exhausted, which is causing the worker throughput to drop to 0. I will proceed to restart pgbouncer to clear the pool and alleviate the current bottleneck.

arguments.summary: The connection pool managed by pgbouncer in the prod namespace was exhausted, causing worker throughput to drop to 0. The pgbouncer service was restarted to clear the pool. The first 10 rows of the failed_jobs table have been exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the job processing and pgbouncer logs to ensure the system is performing as expected. Investigate any specific issues with the failed jobs for further action.
